name: an-select
title: AnSelect
description: `<an-select>` — a select control backed by a real native `<select>` inside the shadow root. Markup stays native: the author writes `<option>` children in the light DOM and the element mirrors them into the shadow select, so option semantics, keyboard interaction, mobile pickers and screen-reader behaviour all come from the platform.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Initial selection. Never reflected back onto the attribute.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Visible label text; also names the control.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: When non-empty, prepends a disabled `value=""` option.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the inner select and bars validation.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Raises `valueMissing` while the value is empty.

events.name: an-select-change
events.description: The user picked another option; `detail = { value, originalEvent }`.

cssProperties.name: --an-select-height
cssProperties.description: Control height; defaults to 2.25rem (2rem sm, 2.75rem lg).

cssProperties.name: --an-select-bg
cssProperties.description: Control background; defaults to the `bg-1` token.

cssProperties.name: --an-select-fg
cssProperties.description: Text and arrow colour; defaults to the `fg-1` token.

cssProperties.name: --an-select-border-color
cssProperties.description: Border colour; defaults to the `border-1` token.

cssProperties.name: --an-select-radius
cssProperties.description: Border radius; defaults to the `radius-md` token.

cssProperties.name: --an-select-font-size
cssProperties.description: Text size; defaults to the `font-size-sm` token.

cssProperties.name: --an-select-padding-x
cssProperties.description: Horizontal padding; defaults to the `space-3` token.

cssProperties.name: --an-select-focus-ring
cssProperties.description: Focus outline colour; defaults to the `accent-9` token.

cssParts.name: label
cssParts.description: The visible `<label>`; rendered only when `label` is non-empty.

cssParts.name: chevron
cssParts.description: The decorative arrow drawn over the select.
